{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.32

|gr1= Lights

|arg= global

|descr= Returns [[true]] if vehicle headlights are on otherwise [[false]].

|s1= [[isLightOn]] vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - vehicle with headlights

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|p21= vehicle: [[Object]] - vehicle with search light on a turret

|p22= turret: [[Turret Path]]
